title: Buenos Aires landfill
summary: Follow the methane plume above the Complejo Ambiental Norte III landfill through three satellite products and a common plume-analysis workflow.
interpretation: HyGAS retrieves EnMAP enhancement from Level-1 radiance and ingests the EMIT and GHGSat Level-2 products. The case compares a fixed integration area with scale-aware plume segmentation. EnMAP and GHGSat observed the site close in time; EMIT observed it later that day, so plume evolution matters when interpreting differences.
acquisitionNote: 12 January 2024, UTC: GHGSat 14:45:16; EnMAP 14:46:53; EMIT 18:59:17. These are same-day acquisitions, not a strictly simultaneous three-sensor observation.

title: Turkmenistan gas compression station
summary: Explore how three missions resolve methane plumes near the Korpedje gas compression station when plume masks follow the same physical criteria.
interpretation: PRISMA and EnMAP Level-1 retrievals join a GHGSat Level-2 product in a common analysis. Smoothing, morphology and minimum plume area are defined in metres and rescaled to each sensor's grid. The panels preserve their original units and separate colour scales. Source variability during the acquisition window limits direct comparisons of emission rates.
acquisitionNote: 11 September 2024, UTC: GHGSat 06:36:16; PRISMA 07:11:43; EnMAP 07:55:47. The three acquisitions span about 79 minutes.

title: Pakistan gas processing complex
summary: A pair of observations 76 seconds apart illustrates the shared downstream treatment of provider enhancement and uncertainty products.
interpretation: This example starts from EMIT and GHGSat Level-2 products. HyGAS applies common physical segmentation criteria and wind treatment to support plume integration and flux analysis. The different provider uncertainty definitions remain relevant when reading the uncertainty maps.
acquisitionNote: 28 February 2024, UTC: GHGSat 04:34:05; EMIT 04:35:21. The observations are separated by 76 seconds.

title: Buenos Aires: EnMAP / Tanager-1 revisit
summary: Revisit the same landfill on two different dates to examine retrieval behaviour over a heterogeneous urban and industrial background.
interpretation: The published experiment compares scene-wide and column-wise matched-filter configurations within each scene. The gallery shows the column-wise examples. This is a non-simultaneous revisit: differences between the two dates cannot establish a contemporaneous sensor-accuracy ranking or an emission trend.
acquisitionNote: EnMAP: 9 March 2024, 14:24:31 UTC. Tanager-1: 26 June 2025, 14:44:19 UTC. These observations were acquired more than a year apart.
